notes.people: Agreed 2026-10-02: the people I travelled with can be in a photo, never its subject. In: seen from behind, in silhouette, or too small to recognise. Out: portraits and frames where a recognisable face is the point. So 9768 and 0021 are out; 9762 (facing the camera) and 9858 (profile) are checked at 1000px for whether a face reads; 9800, 9825, 9866, 0009, 0067 stay. I ask them before their frames go live.
